title: Stripe event in the inbox
caption: platform.stripe_events.status. /stripe-events lists failed and ignored first and offers Reprocess on those two only; the answer (202) comes before the worker runs.

states.label: received
states.detail: Stored by the webhook receiver; queued on `platform-stripe-events`.

states.label: ignored
states.detail: No OTA found, unhandled type or switch off. **Reprocess**.

states.label: failed
states.detail: After 5 tries; `last_error` as `CODE: message`. Fix the cause, then **Reprocess**.
